answer: Force every agent to build a bridge between two independent worlds: to earn paid work it must show matching, verifiable activity in two unrelated domains because a sybil farmer can fake one history cheaply but faking two consistent ones per clone costs real effort. Stand the proof on a knoll, in plain sight: every credential is public and timestamped, so anyone can check it. Add a crystal rule — any peer may challenge a credential at any time, and a failed challenge burns the stake behind it. One fake bridge might hold; a thousand identical bridges collapse under the same inspection.
